name: report-styles
description: Report styles: IBCS (for the CFO; the only style that follows the IBCS® Standards) and seven styles that borrow elements of the IBCS notation — Showcase, Soft, Graphic, Annual, Wallboard, Contrast, Terminal — each in light and dark, one page layout and the same numbers in every style; a style and theme switch for web apps, Power BI themes and Deneb overrides.
